brief:
Israeli prosecutors filed indictment charges Sunday against two minors aged 14 and 16 from Kiryat Motzkin in the Haifa District Court for Youth Affairs, Shehab Wire reported. The teenagers face allegations of carrying out assignments on behalf of a person identified in the filing only by initials.

The indictment represents a rare case involving minors in Israel's security apparatus. Court documents did not elaborate on the nature of the tasks the youths allegedly performed or provide full identifying information for the person said to have directed them. The case comes before the youth division of Israel's central district court system.
